versions.content: If Development Error Reporting is turned on and the sources parameter contains an unknown (unconfigured) wakeup source, EcuM_Validate- WakeupEvent shall ignore the call and send the ECUM_E_UNKNOWN_WAKEUP_ SOURCE error message to the DET module.

If EcuMDevErrorDetect is enabled and the sources pa- rameter contains an unknown (unconfigured) wakeup source, EcuM_Validate- WakeupEvent shall ignore the call and report the ECUM_E_UNKNOWN_WAKEUP_ SOURCE to Det.
